grammarFocus: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not。
title: Meal Planning for a Busy Week
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage:
A
Li Wei is a busy office worker in Shanghai. He wants to eat well, but he has little time to cook. On Sunday, he plans his meals for the week. He checks his fridge. There are a few eggs, a little milk, and some vegetables. He needs to buy more food. He also sees a little cheese and a few carrots. He makes a shopping list.

B
At the supermarket, Li Wei thinks about his choices. He should buy some chicken and fish. He should not buy too many snacks. He says, "I have much work this week, so I need quick meals." He buys a few tomatoes, a little rice, and many apples. He also buys a little cheese and a few carrots. He does not buy many snacks because he wants to eat healthy food. He buys only a few biscuits for his tea. He also buys a little yogurt and a few bananas. He thinks, "I should not buy much ice cream. It is not good for me." He pays for his food and goes home.

C
At home, Li Wei prepares his meals. He makes a little soup and a few sandwiches. He puts them in boxes for lunch. He thinks, "I should eat more vegetables and less meat." He also decides to drink much water every day. He should not drink too much coffee. He wants to be healthy. Now he is ready for the week.

grammar.title: 数量表达与建议：much / many / a little / a few；should / should not
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用 many 修饰可数名词复数（如 many apples），用 much 修饰不可数名词（如 much water）。a few 表示“几个”，修饰可数名词复数；a little 表示“一点”，修饰不可数名词。should 表示“应该”，should not 表示“不应该”，用来给出建议。
grammar.example: He should not buy too many snacks.

questions.prompt: There are ______ eggs in the fridge.
questions.explanation: eggs 是可数名词复数，表示“几个”用 a few。
questions.evidence: There are a few eggs, a little milk, and some vegetables.

questions.explanation: water 是不可数名词，表示“大量”用 much。
questions.evidence: He also decides to drink much water every day.

questions.prompt: You ______ eat more vegetables. It is good for you.
questions.evidence: I should eat more vegetables and less meat.

questions.prompt: You ______ drink too much coffee. It is not good.
questions.explanation: 表示建议“不应该”用 should not。
questions.evidence: He should not drink too much coffee.
